* OTA-WIDE-SKY130 : rail-to-rail input, two-stage Miller OTA (v3)
* Stage 1: NMOS pair folded via PMOS cascodes + PMOS pair, summed in a cascoded NMOS mirror load
*          (cascoded mirror equalizes drain voltages -> negligible systematic offset in the
*           low-VDD/cold dead zone where both input pairs lose headroom)
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source driver with VDD-referenced PMOS current-source load (good PSRR)
* IREF (10uA) enters IBIAS from VSS -> NMOS diode reference
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* ---------------- bias ----------------
XMB1 IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=2
XMB2 VBP1 IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=2
XMB3 VBP1 VBP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.5 m=2
* PMOS cascode gate bias: VBP2 = VDD - I*RBP - Vsg(MB5), tracks VDD
RBP VDD NX 25k
XMB5 VBP2 VBP2 NX VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 m=2
XMB6 VBP2 IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=2
CBP2 VBP2 VDD 0.5p
* NMOS cascode gate bias: VBN2 = Vgs(MB8) + I*RBN, tracks VSS
XMB7 VBN2 VBP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.5 m=2
RBN VBN2 NY 13k
XMB8 NY NY VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=2
CBN2 VBN2 VSS 0.5p
* ---------------- input stage ----------------
* NMOS differential pair and tail (20uA)
XMTN TAILN IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=4
XM1 NA VINN TAILN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 m=2
XM2 NB VINP TAILN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 m=2
* PMOS differential pair and tail (20uA)
XMTP TAILP VBP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.5 m=4
XM3 NC VINN TAILP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 m=2
XM4 ND VINP TAILP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 m=2
* top current sources (20uA) and PMOS cascodes folding the NMOS pair
XM5 NA VBP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.5 m=4
XM6 NB VBP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.5 m=4
XM7 NDIO VBP2 NA VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 m=2
XM8 N1 VBP2 NB VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.5 m=2
* cascoded NMOS mirror load (sums both pairs); PMOS pair drains enter at cascode sources
XM9 NDIO VBN2 NC VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=2
XM10 N1 VBN2 ND VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=2
XM11 NC NDIO VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=2
XM12 ND NDIO VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=50 L=0.5 m=2
* ---------------- output stage ----------------
XMD VOUT N1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=70 L=0.3 m=1
XML VOUT VBP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.5 m=20
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
RZ N1 NRZ 1k
CC NRZ VOUT 4.7p
.ends DUT
